sourceRegistry.name: Ministry of Jal Shakti — State-wise wetland distribution, National Wetland Decadal Change Atlas (2017–18)

CWC began monitoring 2,843 glacial lakes and water bodies across the wider Himalayan river basins in 2025; the 681 figure is the India-located subset.

sourceRegistry.name: Central Water Commission and ISRO/NRSC — River Basin Atlas of India

sourceRegistry.name: Ministry of Tourism — 340 mountain peaks opened for mountaineering/trekking
